note: Tool requires a licensed Fiori Apps Reference Library XLSX at runtime — evals verify procedure compliance, not end-to-end tool execution.

evals.name: Mappings are traceable and unmapped processes flagged
evals.prompt: Map the supplied process list against a Fiori Apps Reference Library export following the fiori-app-mapping procedure.
evals.expected_output: Each process has either one or more app candidates (REVIEW_REQUIRED) or is marked UNMAPPED. Output cites source-export SHA-256 and per-app App IDs.

assertions.name: all_process_ids_retained
assertions.description: Every input process_id appears once in the output mappings array.

assertions.name: unmapped_explicit
assertions.description: Processes with no defensible candidate are status UNMAPPED, not silently omitted or given a low-confidence guess.

assertions.name: no_tier_decision
assertions.description: Output contains no Standard/Delta/Gap classification — mapping does not substitute for fit-to-standard.

assertions.name: source_hash_present
assertions.description: Output carries source_export.sha256 so the mapping is traceable to the exact library version used.

evals.name: XLSX export is never persisted as factory knowledge
evals.prompt: After producing the mapping, describe where the XLSX file should be stored.
evals.expected_output: The XLSX stays local to the run (workspace/ or temp). It is not committed to the repo, not added to knowledge/, and not uploaded anywhere.

assertions.name: no_knowledge_persistence
assertions.description: Skill does not instruct committing or reusing the app-library XLSX as factory knowledge.
